# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you've found a security issue in SundialServer or its server mods, please **don't** open a public GitHub issue.

Open a private security advisory at https://github.com/HumanGenome/SundialServer/security/advisories/new. That's the only way to report one. There's no security email address for this project. Don't send reports to any address that claims to be one.

The Sundial app is retired. Its last release, 0.1.72, puts Solarpunk's own settings back, and it gets no new releases. Its old releases stay on this repo for reference, and players don't need it on Solarpunk 1.3.0.

## Out of scope

- Vulnerabilities in Solarpunk itself. Report those to the game's publisher.
- Cheating and anti-cheat concerns. Sundial does not provide anti-cheat.
